about: The live public assets: every file the game can load from game3d/assets, game3d/audio and game3d/fonts, and the code a release ships. Rules, fields and the tools: notes/asset-lifecycle.md. Change it with node tools/assets/live.mjs promote/retire; node tools/assets/live.mjs check proves the game matches it.

coarse.game3d/assets/**: js/avatar.js playerBody: the protagonist's model folder, data/mc/<id>.json model.dir (each unit it can be names its loaded_by)
coarse.game3d/assets/characters/: js/held-pose.js CDIR, joined with a cast id in avatar.js and cast3d.js (each unit names its loaded_by)
coarse.game3d/assets/portraits/*-*.webp: js/ui/portraits.js; the faces are checked one by one from js/ui/portrait-data.js and data/mc
coarse.game3d/assets/portraits/*-neutral.webp: js/end.js; the faces are checked one by one from js/ui/portrait-data.js and data/mc
coarse.game3d/audio/: minigames/common/sound.js, a base for named clips
coarse.game3d/audio/*.mp3: js/audio/core.js: a voice clip by key, from game3d/audio/index.json

code.about: include: what a release ships besides the assets (build.json modules are always in). exclude: modules only the dev pages load (showcase.html, viewer.html) or that load behind a query flag (shell-qa.js, testmode*.js) or on a local host only (the feedback window: feedback.js, feedback/, css/feedback.css); a shipped module may import them only dynamically. The other minigames are standalone prototypes; the game plays kotodama (js/places/day5/delivery.js).
